# Tatyova, Benthic Druid: "Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you gain 1 life and draw a card."
landfall = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAnd(children=(
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land'),
        )),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=Seq(steps=(
        A(Verb.GAIN_LIFE, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
        A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
    )),
)
abilities = [landfall, *compiled]
